title: Manyhands JSON v1 host mutation data
description: The data of a host approve or host replace envelope: the host and the key the request names. A pin that is stored is shown by no effect, so this and the outcome say what the request did: success for a pin that was stored, noop for a host already pinned to the key. A request stopped as host_mismatch carries it too, with the key the host presented instead; no pin has changed then. Any other request that is refused carries no data.

algorithm.description: The algorithm of the key the request names.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the key the request names: SHA256: and the digest of the public key, as a pin holds it.

presented_algorithm.description: The algorithm of the key the host presented, when that is not the key the request names. Null otherwise.

presented_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the key the host presented, when that is not the key the request names. Null otherwise.
